sections.title: Data controller
body: The data controller is {{legalName}}, registered office at {{address}}, VAT No. {{vatNumber}}.
For any request about personal data you can write to {{privacyEmail}}.

sections.title: Data we process
body: Browsing data: the servers hosting the website automatically log IP address, date and time, requested page and browser type to keep the service running and secure.
Data provided through the request form: chosen division, project details (type, area or power, location, timeline), first name, last name, company, role, email, phone, message and any attachment.
Proof of consent: together with the request we record date and time, page and language of submission, IP address and the choices made on privacy and marketing communications.

sections.title: Purposes and legal basis
body: Answering information and quote requests and managing the resulting business contacts: pre-contractual measures (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Protecting the form from abuse and automated submissions, using technical checks that rely on no cookies or external services: the controller's legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Sending marketing communications and updates, only if you gave the optional consent in the form: consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time.
Complying with legal, tax and accounting obligations: legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).

sections.title: Whether providing data is required
body: Fields marked as required are needed to answer your request: without them we cannot follow up.
Consent to marketing communications is optional, and refusing it has no effect on how your request is handled.

sections.title: How data is processed
body: Requests are stored in SRAGROUP's internal management system, hosted on our hosting provider's servers, and only authorised staff of the relevant division can access them with personal credentials.
We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures: encrypted connection (HTTPS), protected passwords, logged access and attachments that are not publicly accessible.

sections.title: Retention period
body: Requests and their attachments: 24 months from the last contact; if the request leads to a contract, 10 years as required by civil and tax law.
Data for marketing purposes: until consent is withdrawn.
Browsing data: as long as needed for the security of the service and no longer than 12 months, unless required to investigate offences.
You can ask for earlier deletion of your data at any time.

sections.title: Recipients
body: Data is processed by authorised SRAGROUP staff and may be shared with the providers that support us as processors (Art. 28 GDPR): hosting of the website and management system, email service and IT support.
To display its typefaces the website uses Google Fonts, which receives the visitor's IP address. The Google Maps map on the Contact page loads only after your consent or your click.
Data is not disclosed to the public or sold to third parties.

sections.title: Transfers outside the European Union
body: Using Google services may involve transferring data to the United States. Google LLC participates in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, recognised as adequate by the European Commission (Art. 45 GDPR).

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can exercise at any time your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection (Arts. 15-22 GDPR) and withdraw consent, without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing, by writing to {{privacyEmail}}.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.garanteprivacy.it).

sections.title: Changes
body: This notice may be updated; the date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.

sections.title: What cookies are
body: Cookies and similar technologies (such as the browser's localStorage) are small pieces of information a website saves on the user's device to remember browsing data or preferences.

sections.title: Strictly necessary tools
body: sragroup-consent (localStorage, first party): stores your cookie choices so the banner does not appear on every visit. It stays until you clear it in your browser or we update the categories. No consent required.

The staff-only area (/backend) uses two first-party technical cookies: sra_crm (sign-in session, deleted when the browser closes) and crm_lang (panel language, 12 months). They do not concern website visitors.

sections.title: Analytics cookies
body: The website currently uses no analytics cookies.
If statistics tools (for example Google Analytics 4) are enabled in the future, they will load only after consent to the "Analytics" category and this page will be updated with the list of cookies.

sections.title: Third-party content
body: Google Maps (Google Ireland Ltd.): the map on the Contact page loads only if you accepted the "Marketing" category or click "Show map". Once loaded, Google may set its own cookies (for example NID). Privacy notice: policies.google.com/privacy.
Google Fonts: the website's typefaces are downloaded from Google's servers, which receive the IP address but set no cookies.
The request form uses internal anti-spam checks that set no cookies.

sections.title: Managing your preferences
body: You can change or withdraw consent at any time through the "Cookie preferences" link in the website footer. You can also delete cookies and site data from your browser settings.

sections.title: Contact
body: For information about the use of cookies write to {{privacyEmail}}.
